text:
jamie: Quick sync — we need a concrete canary + flag handoff for the Optics rollout (model routing + per-tenant opt-in). Main asks: staged regions, KPIs, and clear rollback triggers. Who owns the runbook?

alisa: I can own the runbook but need the exact gating KPIs from product. what's 'optics' success look like?

jamie: Primary KPIs: customer error rate delta <= 0.3pp, P50 latency delta <= +30ms, token cost change < +5%. Secondary: NPS / user-reported regressions.

michael: For canary shape propose: 3 waves — 2% tenant sample (shadow + light traffic), 10% regional warmup (us-west/us-east), then 50% NA + 10% EU ramp. Rollback if any KPI breach sustained for 10m with >3 consecutive alerts.

sara: Ops notes: need per-tenant circuit-breaker and auto-fallback to `model-v1` on first failure. Also require per-route tracing enabled and `optics-canary` metric tags.

jamie: Good. Can we make the rollback rules deterministic? e.g., thresholds + sustained window + operator confirm?

alisa: Yes. Proposal: immediate automatic fallback when 1) 5xx rate > 0.5% absolute increase OR 2) tail latency (P95) > +200ms for 5m. For softer breaches (error +0.3pp or p95 +100ms) open paging but hold rollout.

michael: Also want to add quality guard: a small set of 30 user-specified prompts (eval set) run every minute against canary vs baseline. If regression > 2% tokens flagged, pause.

jamie: Love the eval set idea. Who maintains the prompt set? Product owns it, ops runs it. @sara can you add the check to the preflight?

sara: Yep. I'll add it to the preflight job and to the alerting dashboard. Need the list in a CSV.

jamie: I'll export and drop it in the /runbooks/optics/canary folder.

deploybot: deploy scheduled: optics-canary-run 3310007777 by alisa at 2023-10-12T15:00:00Z (dry-run). Status: queued. :gear:

michael: A couple of operational details:
- sticky session affinity for A/B to avoid cross-variant bleed
- feature-flag keys: `optics_enabled`, `optics_experiment_id`
- sampling should be seeded by tenant ID then by user to keep cohorts stable

jamie: Add region-aware rollout policy: prefer low-latency regions first. EU ramp only after NA 50% stable for 24h on primary KPIs.

alisa: For telemetry, we need per-flag telemetry: tokens, latency, error, cost-per-token, and model-fallback-count. Dashboards must have per-region + per-tenant slices.

michael: One more: fallback hierarchy — same model but lower temperature? no, better: 1) old routing -> `model-v1`, 2) regional fallback to cheaper variant `optics-quant` if capacity high, 3) degrade to synchronous short-mode (limits tokens) as last resort.

jamie: That hierarchy works. Add explicit kill-switch: one button that sets `optics_enabled=false` org-wide + auto-notify customers.

alisa: I'll draft runbook steps and the Slack ops play snippet. Example snippet:```
# ops playbook excerpt
if breach:
  set_flag('optics_enabled', false)
  notify('#ops-alerts', 'Optics rollback triggered')
  run rollback_tests()
```

sara: Ops will run a dry-run on staging today. We should schedule a short sync with customer success for communication templates.

jamie: Schedule invite: I'll loop in @michael and @sara and CS. Final ask: can we ship the runbook + preflight jobs by EOD Fri?

michael: Thumbs up — aiming for EOD. I'll push the sampling + affinity code and the eval harness.

alisa: I'll create the dashboard panels and alerts. Will post runbook link here when done.

jamie: Thanks everyone. We'll iterate on thresholds post-first-wave. :thumbsup:
